xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5338: Conversation diff view: add a rendered Preview for Markdown files and an Open file action

plan.title: Conversation diff view: add a rendered Preview for Markdown files and an Open file action
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: The conversation diff panel shows a Markdown file only as raw source lines and has no control to open the file, so reading a document a conversation wrote means finding it again in the Files dock.
narratives.Proposal: Add a DiffPanel-owned file bar above the patch with a Diff | Preview switch for Markdown files and an Open file action (openBeside). Preview renders the after side with the existing MarkdownTab: an added file from its patch text, other files through the explorer read (working tree for All turns and turns, HEAD for vs main, the working tree with the note "Showing the current file" for Compare). Relative links render as plain text until #5337. The pop-out window gets the switch through a root URL param. No server change.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No change to DockDiffView (the dock Changes diff view).
- No resolution of relative Markdown links to files (that is #5337); only the interim plain-text guard.
- No new HTTP route and no server change.
- No exact after side for Compare or older agent-route turns; they show the current file with the note.
- No Preview for non-Markdown viewer types (CSV, SVG).
- No persistence of the Diff/Preview choice in the URL or preferences.
- No Open file button in the pop-out window.
- No second Markdown renderer.
- No polyrepo path mapping beyond PRD D-8.

autoDecisions.summary: After side for All turns and one turn = the working-tree file read through the explorer; vs main = HEAD; added files = patch text
autoDecisions.rationale: Verified in conversation-diffs.ts and checkpoint-manager.ts: the conversation routes diff base→working tree and vs-main diffs base...HEAD, so these reads are exact; the patch of a new file holds all its lines.

autoDecisions.summary: Compare and older agent-route turns read the working tree and show "Showing the current file"
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue names this fallback; the explorer read supports only the working tree and HEAD, and Compare is not in the issue's scope list.

autoDecisions.summary: Open file uses the existing openBeside seam (PAN-5287) with no Stage-tab fallback, and is hidden where no Stage deck exists (pop-out)
autoDecisions.rationale: openBeside is on main and already used by DockDiffView's "Open beside chat"; the pop-out window has no deck to open into.

autoDecisions.summary: Relative links: opt-in plainRelativeLinks prop on ChatMarkdown/MarkdownTab, passed only by the diff preview; use #5337's seam instead if it has merged
autoDecisions.rationale: Requirement 7 needs a guard before #5337; an opt-in prop leaves chat and the file pane unchanged and keeps the overlap with #5337 small.

autoDecisions.summary: The Diff/Preview choice is per file, resets when the file changes, and is not stored in the URL
autoDecisions.rationale: Requirement 4 says the choice applies to the file being viewed; Diff stays the default.

autoDecisions.summary: Fix the pre-existing All turns file selection (diffFilePath dropped without diffTurnId) inside this issue
autoDecisions.rationale: Requirement 2 names All turns; without the two-line fix a Markdown file can never be previewed in that scope.
The issue names DiffPanel and the pop-out; the new preview component is reusable for a follow-up.

autoDecisions.summary: No server change: no repoRoot added to the full/turn responses
autoDecisions.rationale: Root folder equals the repo top level for issue workspaces and normal projects; vs-main already returns repoRoot; a polyrepo mismatch degrades to an explicit message.
